policy: Initial cross-division risks are evidence-backed observations from the draft repository and known operating constraints; ratings are provisional and require owner review. Do not invent owners or incidents. Risk Division has independent challenge and stop-only advisory authority; it cannot approve execution or override deterministic controls.

records.description: OCC remains a draft branch rather than an operating control plane; governance records and dashboard code are not yet deployed, staffed or persistently operated.
records.mitigation: Keep readiness at building; require review of the foundation, named owners, authenticated durable records, real handoffs and witnessed exercises before operational claims.
evidence: OCC PR #1 and PR #6 remain draft/unmerged; readiness register documents missing deployment and owners.

records.description: An agent, model or integration could exceed intended authority if approval boundaries are only documented and not enforced at runtime/tool permissions.
records.mitigation: Keep external, financial, wallet, trading, publishing, merge and deployment actions disabled by default; implement least-privilege tool enforcement and negative permission tests before any live scope.
evidence: Draft risk-control policy and AI workforce role contracts explicitly deny execution authority; no runtime permission enforcement is yet verified.

records.description: Candidate market-data providers may not have suitable Ontario access, licensing, freshness, provenance, quotas or rights for the intended automated use.
records.mitigation: Keep all sources research-only; complete source-specific official terms and Ontario review, sample capture, freshness tests and independent-provider validation before approval.
evidence: Draft market-data source registry has 11 candidates, pending terms and Canada reviews, and no production-approved source.

records.description: Position, order or fill state could become uncertain during partial exits, simulator exceptions or restart, risking duplicate or inconsistent position accounting.
records.mitigation: Maintain paper-only mode; review PR #42 and its parent branch, then run no-fill, confirmed-fill, exception and restart reconciliation tests before any readiness upgrade.
evidence: PolyBot PR #42 is draft/unmerged; staged-exit reconciliation changes have not been executed through tests.

records.description: Internal revenue and commitment records could be mistaken for verified cash or complete financial statements without bank reconciliation, tax and liability coverage.
records.mitigation: Keep CAD 0 spend ceiling; distinguish estimated, accepted and cash-received amounts; label external balances unknown until owner-reviewed source evidence exists.
evidence: Draft Finance controls contain an empty commitment register and no bank connection or independently verified balance.

records.description: Incident response is not staffed or production-tested; written procedures and empty registers do not establish monitoring, responder coverage or recovery capability.
records.mitigation: Confirm accountable responders and escalation route; implement protected evidence handling; execute a witnessed tabletop and target-specific recovery rehearsal.
evidence: Risk policy and lifecycle are draft; incident register remains empty; no named responder, monitoring or production evidence is established.

records.description: Existing ecommerce listings may have poor unit economics or fulfilment outcomes because current costs, shipping, variants, fees, returns and customer experience have not been freshly verified.
records.mitigation: Complete a read-only listing and unit-economics audit; do not publish, purchase, change accounts or run paid promotion until evidence and approval exist.
evidence: OCC readiness register records no verified sales, unit economics or fulfilment quality and prohibits publishing.

records.description: Animora's original characters, brand assets, site functionality and integrations could be lost or drift during future rebuild work without a fresh baseline.
records.mitigation: Inventory and preserve current site and asset state before changes; do not consume Lovable credits or publish changes without explicit approval.
evidence: OCC readiness register identifies Lyra, Kaito, Miko and Solen preservation and no-cost rebuild constraints.
